pirs.statement: Will the Tidö bloc (M/KD/L + SD support) hold voting cohesion on confidence-adjacent and values files (migration HD01SfU35, citizenship HD024194) through the 2026-09-13 terminal event of the mandate?
pirs.trigger: Any L or KD defection on a confidence-adjacent division before the September poll.

pirs.statement: Will a labour-market or macro shock (GDP undershoot vs IMF WEO Apr-2026 ~2.1% T+1, or a-kassa/pension salience HD10524/HD03130) reframe the cycle verdict toward economic competence?
pirs.trigger: IMF-divergent CPI print or unemployment breakout before the poll.

pirs.statement: Will municipal equalisation (HD10526) and municipal health strain (HD01SoU32) become the decisive fairness/delivery cleavage of the mandate verdict?
pirs.trigger: New municipal deficit reports or coalition resistance attributable to HD10526.

pirs.statement: Will agency capacity (Polismyndigheten, Migrationsverket, municipalities) convert the mandate's legislative throughput (HD01JuU37, HD01SfU35, HD01SoU32) into demonstrable delivery, or will implementation gaps falsify the delivery claim?
pirs.trigger: Statskontoret or agency report documenting an implementation miss on a flagship statute.

prior_cycle_ingestion.note: Carried-forward from prior-cycle year-ahead (2026-05-27 and same-date 2026-05-31): all four standing PIRs (cohesion, labour-macro, equalisation, delivery) roll forward into the cycle frame with election-band horizons. No prior PIR was answered or superseded this cycle.
